<issue>
CoreProperties.created returns modified datetime instead of created datetime

#### Description

The `created` property of `CoreProperties` is returning the modified datetime value instead of the actual created datetime.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from docx.opc.coreprops import CoreProperties

# Load a document with core properties
# Assuming you have a document with both created and modified dates set
core_props = CoreProperties(element)

# This should return the created datetime but returns modified datetime instead
created_date = core_props.created
modified_date = core_props.modified

print(f"Created: {created_date}")
print(f"Modified: {modified_date}")
# Both values will be the same (the modified datetime)
```

When accessing the `created` property, it incorrectly returns the same value as the `modified` property instead of the actual creation date stored in the document properties.
</issue>
